create_patch_embed: create a PatchEmbed module to convert 2D images into patch embeddings for vision transformers
build_patch_embed_custom: build a PatchEmbed layer with custom image size, patch size, and embedding dimensions
test_make_2tuple: test the make_2tuple utility function that converts integers or tuples to 2-element tuples
run_patch_embed_forward: run the PatchEmbed forward pass to transform (B,C,H,W) tensors into (B,N,D) patch embeddings
summarize_patch_embed_flops: summarize the PatchEmbed flops method that computes floating-point operations for the embedding layer
